summary: Fair transfer of pooler-k-halves (selector 1.069x/1.037x, judge 1.063x/1.123x on pooler verify_16/32) to qkv_gate; the m=128 rationale is stale: master 36c26199 already runs cuBLASLt cell B (nvjet 40x64 4x2 TNN ~15.5 us, no splitKreduce) at qkv m=128. Baseline against cell B, give the new path its own flag, expect a smaller m=128 gain; m=256 (~20 -> ~16-17 us) is the real bet.
justification: qkv_gate n 2304 k 8192 at m=256: nvjet 96x64 2x4 ~20.0 us vs 9.8 us floor, ~96 CTAs < 132 SMs over full K; K-split raises parallelism. pooler-k-halves (ce808e5a): strided bmm without copy, 128x128 tile at m=256, selector under-predicted judge. Weakest link: wave quantization for narrow N=2304 (72/144/192 CTAs depending on tile and S); no sibling layer predicts the tile cuBLAS picks; the selector contains it. Prior: pooler-k-halves (different layer); bf16-cublaslt-algo-pick-in-prepare-m128-m256 did not change problem shape.
confounders: combo-rowowner-reduce-free-m1-qkv-o-plus-naive (landed): cell B (LT_FLAG) is the m=128 incumbent; time whatever master runs after _lt_prepare; own flag checked before _lt_route_ok; _ab_component returns it before LT_FLAG so a miss falls back to cell B.
sglang-gemm-dispatch-parity: m=256 incumbent and m=128 fallback.
pooler-nn-layout-widen-m256 / restack-three-cell-wins: keep the new flag separate from nn_ok/nn_p256_ok.
bf16-m32-swapab-wgmma-triton / bf16-restack-m16: gate at m<=32 first; no interaction.
interference: No companion: the prepare-time selector times master's actual path and the four candidates (S=2/4, TN/NN) in-process with cold L2 and prints medians, IQR and tile names.
rules_flags: Precision fine (S bf16 partial roundings + final add; p.sum(0) accumulates fp32).
kernel_fn gates only on cfg layer and exact cfg m (128, 256) plus a state flag/dict; no print/try/.item()/state mutation; fresh outputs.
One lossless NN repack W.t().contiguous() in prepare, in state (37.7 MB total).

Selector and profiler in prepare only; do not assert an exact kernel count (S=4 p.sum launches reduce_kernel; CUPTI may return none); reject copies/contiguous and splitKreduce; any selector exception keeps master.
open_questions: Print the tile cuBLAS picks for all four candidates.
At m=128 can any candidate beat cell B's 15.5 us by >= 1.02x after the add?
Run after _lt_prepare; choose once on state A; pass to state B via _ab_flags.
